role: Original substantive author FIRST, sealed before case/profile serialization and stock binding
actualGap: The exact BcP6.1 source includes responses to stimuli in addition to fundamental life requirements and enzyme effects. Existing11a/b assess germination and yeast, without an observable stimulus response. This is a design omission, not a missing already completed learner trial.

scientificDecisionBeforeEditing.boundedAction: Add exactly lab15-11-c, a future practical gentle-touch Mimosa response with sham treatment, original records and an independent handling-confound transfer.
scientificDecisionBeforeEditing.whyThisDesign: A rapid measurable plant response fits stimulus responsiveness without human sensory experiments, wild capture, injury, chemicals or hazardous heating. Mechanical stimuli and spontaneous/circadian/environment-related movement must be separated with controls.
scientificDecisionBeforeEditing.mainProtocolCommitment: Six individually identified healthy fully open plants,3 matched/randomised touch versus3 sham; constant diffuse light/time/temperature, fixed camera, one gentle soft-brush contact at a leaflet only versus matched near-leaf motion without contact. Count fully closed leaflet pairs per visible eligible pinna at baseline/5/15/30/60s, count ambiguous pairs separately; plants are independent replicates, leaflets/time points are not. No force escalation if no response.
scientificDecisionBeforeEditing.analysisCommitment: Predefine C/N fraction and change from baseline per plant; compare mean changes as percentage points with raw range and ambiguous bounds. A small sample supports only a condition-bounded inference. Any arithmetic teaching example is explicitly invented and never replaces the own practical data. No neuronal, calcium-channel, pain, memory or learning conclusion from video.
scientificDecisionBeforeEditing.transferCommitment: One case includes a second independently planned and actually future-performed safe follow-up: a fictional report says moving a pot can close leaves before direct touch. Learner designs an appropriate control to test handling as alternative cause, with six separate rested plants and the same response measurement; safe maximum movement10mm slowly over at least2s, no fall/tap/tilt. Transfer planning precedes any control hint/model solution.
scientificDecisionBeforeEditing.protectionCommitment: Cultivated plants only, no thorns handled, no ingestion/contact with eyes, no cuts/heating/electricity/anaesthetics, no repeated triggering. One event per plant/day; healthy/open baseline, monitor afterwards and return to plant care; stop for visible damage/wilting or distress-like plant deterioration, accidental jolt, contact contamination or unscorable view. No guaranteed reopening time or response quota.
scientificDecisionBeforeEditing.profileCommitment: Append only e5, e5 required coverage, a genuinely new handling-control variation axis and11c brief. Keep old e1-e4, both old briefs and variation axis exact. No14-profile rewrite.
scientificDecisionBeforeEditing.demonstrationCommitment: Existing minimum2 independent demonstrations retained. The one new whole case requires its main controlled response and an independently planned practical transfer; no fabricated second case label and no observed execution asserted.
scientificDecisionBeforeEditing.openBoundaries: Source/course selection and whole-goal atomicity dissent remain open. This addition proves neither that9ace/335 are atomic nor that the BcP source binds all stated chemistry courses.

primaryScienceScope: Current official curriculum operator and primary research support feasibility and a bounded interpretation; exact counts/timings/classroom handling limits are this authors proposed adaptation, not a published validated protocol.
